question: Could you analyze our data and identify which ten-year period starting from any movie release year present in the data had the largest number of films, considering consecutive ten-year periods beginning at each unique year? Only output the start year and the total count for that specific period.
sql:
-- Get distinct parsed years
WITH parsed_years AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT 
    TRY_CAST(REGEXP_REPLACE(year, '^[IVXLC]+ ', '') AS INTEGER) as release_year
  FROM Movie
  WHERE TRY_CAST(REGEXP_REPLACE(year, '^[IVXLC]+ ', '') AS INTEGER) IS NOT NULL
),
-- For each distinct year, count films in [year, year+9]
period_counts AS (
  SELECT 
    py.release_year as start_year,
    COUNT(*) as film_count
  FROM parsed_years py
  JOIN Movie m ON TRY_CAST(REGEXP_REPLACE(m.year, '^[IVXLC]+ ', '') AS INTEGER) BETWEEN py.release_year AND py.release_year + 9
  GROUP BY py.release_year
)
SELECT start_year, film_count
FROM period_counts
ORDER BY film_count DESC, start_year ASC
LIMIT 10
